name: SlicerItems
description: Represents the collection of SlicerItem objects contained in a SlicerCache or SlicerCacheLevel object.
remarks: To access the SlicerItems collection that represents the items in a slicer based on data in the workbook or non-OLAP external data, use the SlicerItems property of the SlicerCache object that is associated with the slicer. To access the SlicerItems collection that represents the items in a slicer based on an OLAP data connection, use the SlicerItems property of the SlicerCacheLevel object that represents a level of the hierarchy.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent SlicerCache object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Returns a SlicerItem object from a collection. Read-only.
